name: SearchBar
description: A search field with a ranked result list: tiered fuzzy matching with highlighted matches, keyboard navigation, clear and cancel actions, and optional groups.

fields.mutedForeground: ThemedColor? - group header, empty and hint colour
fields.borderWidth: double? - null draws no border at 0
fields.itemHighlight: StateValue<ThemedColor>? - focused row fill, default accent on hover/press/highlight
fields.highlightColor: ThemedColor? - matched character colour, default primary
fields.shadows: List<BoxShadow>? - surface shadows; empty draws none
fields.minRowHeight: double? - minimum row height for the touch minimum, default 48
fields.showLeading: bool? - leading search icon, default true
fields.showClear: bool? - trailing clear button, default true

notes: Ranking runs through `primitives/search` (`fuzzy_match.dart`, `fuzzy_typo.dart`, `search_index.dart`): the `command` palette ranks through the same files instead of duplicating the algorithm.
The keyboard map is an `InputFeature` (`SearchBarNavFeature`) so the arrows reach the list instead of moving the caret; the same contract the `autocomplete` feature uses.
